purpose: Standing ledger of strategic bets — the compounding-strategy layer on top of the mechanical gates (cooldown/track_record/clone/lead_prescreen). A finding discovered once (competitor research, a track_record pattern, an A/B result) gets banked here as a tracked hypothesis instead of being re-derived every time it's asked about. recommend_slot.py reads this to tag candidates with the bet they'd be testing.
lifecycle: PROPOSED (stated, not yet tested) -> TESTING (a ship is live against it) -> CONFIRMED or KILLED (enough evidence to close it) -> promoted_rule (folded into a permanent playbook rule, e.g. anti_patterns.json / lane_packaging_directions.json)

hypotheses.statement: Clinical-somatic hook framing (present-tense Q-hook + named raga + Hz + cortisol/vagus/nervous-system language) recovers channel reach. Evidence: our own all-time reach leaders used this exact register (Dopamine Reset, Nervous System Healing, our highest-ever CTR 9.36% ship 'Can't Fall Asleep | Raga Yaman Bansuri'), then we drifted to generic-soft framing ('Peace of Mind', 'Healing Frequency', 'Calm Morning') — same-format cohort CTR fell 4.62 (May) -> 3.28 (July). Meanwhile a SMALLER niche competitor (Dhun Detox, 27.8K subs) is riding this exact abandoned formula to 15x view-velocity vs their own older catalog, and Raga Heal/Shanti both show flat-to-accelerating fresh-upload performance using the same register — while our fresh-upload performance is declining. This suggests the decay is channel-specific (packaging drift), not niche-wide.
hypotheses.predicted_metric: A ship using this register should land CTR >= 4.5% (vs the July cohort median 3.28%) and/or beat its lane's recent median views.
hypotheses.source: chat_2026-07-22 — competitor decay research + own reach-leader audit

hypotheses.statement: The 'emotional/healing/heart/comfort/nostalgia' lane does not generate real reach on this channel, regardless of instrument.
hypotheses.predicted_metric: n/a — this is a closed finding, not an open bet.
hypotheses.evidence: Every emotional/heart/comfort/nostalgia ship ever made (n=6-7, all instruments): lifetime TOTAL views = 2,795 — 0.3% of one month's current channel views. track_record: Sarangi×healing = FLOP (n=7, median 299v, CTR 2.92). Every other instrument in this lane is UNTESTED (zero data, not proof of viability). One outlier (Nostalgia Music, CTR 7.15/AVD 40.9%) proves the MUSIC/retention can be excellent, but reach has never once broken ~1,500 views regardless of framing or instrument. Confirmed 2026-07-20 after nearly locking a Sarangi-healing brief that would have been the lane's 7th consecutive weak result.
hypotheses.source: chat_2026-07-20 — user asked 'do you think emotional lane has worked for us'
hypotheses.promoted_rule: Should be folded into anti_patterns.json as a dead-lane detector (pending) — recommend_slot.py enforces it via track_record's FLOP verdict in the interim.

hypotheses.source: chat_2026-07-24 — user challenged the Fri slot; measured both effects separately
hypotheses.statement: CONSUMPTION and LAUNCH-DAY are different effects and they point opposite ways. Consumption (channel impressions by weekday, de-trended vs trailing-7d mean, n=67 days): Mon 129% > Wed 115% > Tue 114% > Thu 106% > Fri 99% > Sun 110% > Sat 90% — the audience watches most Mon-Wed, which is where the banked 'Mondays always spike / place the rested hero on Monday PM' rule came from. But that measures CATALOG consumption. LAUNCH day, measured on true window-free impressions/day at age 4-12d, de-trended against each month's own median (n=110 ships): Fri 199% > Sat 128% > Thu 112% > Tue 106% > Mon 85% > Wed 77% > Sun 61%. Mon-Wed median 89% vs Thu-Fri median 163%. Not outlier-driven (10/16 Fri ships beat their month median vs 6/14 Mon ships). Not a measurement-window artifact either (the age-4-12d window overlaps the Mon-Wed consumption peak slightly more for Fri launches, but that accounts for ~4%, not a 2.3x gap). MECHANISM (untested): Monday's larger viewer pool is soaked up by the catalog giants, so a fresh ship competes hardest for share on exactly the day the pool is biggest — consistent with the banked 'one viewer pool per day; extra ships split it' finding. Friday's pool is smaller but the catalog is quieter, so a new ship takes a larger share of it.
hypotheses.predicted_metric: A ship launched Thu/Fri should post >=1.5x the age-4-12d true impressions/day of a comparable-strength cell launched Mon/Wed in the same month. Falsified if Mon/Wed ships match or beat Thu/Fri over the next ~6 ships.
hypotheses.caveats: OBSERVATIONAL, not randomised — which concept shipped on which day was a human choice, so selection bias is live (if stronger concepts were deliberately placed Mon-Wed, the true Fri advantage would be even larger; if experiments went to Fri, it could be smaller). n=16 Fri / n=14 Mon. Treat as a scheduling PRIOR, not a settled rule, until 6+ deliberate ships test it.

hypotheses.statement: Western-wellness vocabulary in the title lead pulls T1 watch-share; Indian-classical specificity (named raga/instrument leads) pulls India. Observed: wellness-vocab titles 34-41% T1 watch-time (Gratitude 39.5, Productive Day 39.0, Yoga 34.1) vs raga/instrument leads 1-16% (Can't Fall Asleep Raga Yaman 3.4). T1-share correlates only r=0.11 with RPM (AVD dominates) — so this is a REACH-mix lever, not a direct RPM lever.
hypotheses.predicted_metric: A T1-vocab-led ship posts ≥30% T1 watch-share at d7 (channel baseline ~20-25%); the register arm (somatic vs clarity vs spiritual) that wins CTR while holding ≥30% T1 becomes the default T1 register.
hypotheses.caveats: Observational, lane-confounded (T1-heavy titles are mostly morning/uplift — may be the lane T1 wants, not the words). The two linked A/Bs are the controlled test.

hypotheses.source: chat_2026-07-26 — user asked 'any possibility that thumbnail also leads to more impressions?' during Test #50 launch
hypotheses.statement: A thumbnail refresh on a still-ALIVE decaying video can expand impressions (flatten the decay slope), not just convert better. Mechanism: impressions are downstream of predicted performance (expected CTR x expected watch-time); a thumb that lifts real CTR while AVD holds raises the serving score and widens sampling. This is DISTINCT from the banked dead-video finding (Test #43 Brain Detox: CTR +0.7pp, impressions kept falling — no re-expansion once a video is churned). Conditions for the effect: (1) video still in active rotation (Morning Energy = ~27K impr/day at launch), (2) CTR crosses above the alive-morning peer band (~4.3-5.6; baseline 4.4 rising), (3) AVD holds within ~2pp (energy-promise vs calm Yaman music is the risk). If confirmed, re-thumb targeting shifts from 'weak-CTR dead videos' (worthless) to 'fatigued-thumb ALIVE videos' (the 3hr Bansuri + this).
hypotheses.predicted_metric: Test #50 vehicle (Morning Energy Dilruba, DMcoOLvmAyQ, launched 2026-07-26; pre-test slope 53K->27K impr/day, -38% w/w). CONFIRMED if challenger (BOOST YOUR ENERGY) wins/co-leads watch-time share AND w/w impressions slope flattens to better than ~-20% at the 14d read AND AVD within 2pp of ~22 baseline. KILLED-for-alive-videos if challenger wins share but slope stays <=-30% w/w (would extend Test-43's 'conversion not distribution' rule to alive videos). VOID if control wins (no packaging delta applied). Ignore any 3-5 day novelty re-test bump — judge at 14d only.
